name: Chatwoot
description: Native OpenClaw channel plugin for Chatwoot. Chatwoot stays the source of truth for conversations and human support; OpenClaw handles AI execution.

webhookSecret.description: Webhook secret. Native mode verifies X-Chatwoot-Signature (HMAC-SHA256 of "{timestamp}.{raw_body}"); custom mode verifies HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body in webhookHeader.

webhookSignatureMode.description: chatwoot (native X-Chatwoot-Signature, default) or custom (body HMAC in webhookHeader)

webhookHeader.description: Header carrying the webhook HMAC signature (custom mode only)

webhookTimestampToleranceSec.description: Replay window for native signatures in seconds; 0 disables the timestamp check

webhookPath.description: Gateway HTTP path that receives Chatwoot webhooks

receptionTeamId.description: Chatwoot team id that human reception is assigned to

receptionTeamName.description: Optional human-readable reception team name (diagnostics only)

administrationTeamId.description: Chatwoot team id for administration (Level 2). Used to validate agent-requested handoffs.

administrationTeamName.description: Optional human-readable administration team name (diagnostics only)

fallbackModels.description: Deprecated: model failover is owned by OpenClaw core (agents.defaults.model.fallbacks). Accepted for backward compatibility but not used for dispatch.

handoffNotice.description: Customer-facing notice sent when handing off to reception

handoffNoteTemplate.description: Private note added to the conversation on handoff

stateDir.description: Directory for durable plugin state (processed events, handoff status, pending effects)
